1.1: Hakkol maarichin veneerachin, nodrim veniddarim, kohanim uleviyyim veyisreelim, nashim vaavadim. tumtum veanderoginos, nodrim veniddarim umaarichin, aval lo neerachin, sheeno neerach ella zachar vadday unekeva vaddait. cheresh, shote vekatan, niddarin veneerachin, aval lo nodrin velo maarichin, mippene sheen bahem daat. pachut mibben chodesh, niddar aval lo neerach:
1.2: Hannachri, rabbi meir omer neerach aval lo maarich. rabbi yehuda omer, maarich aval lo neerach. ze vaze modim, shennodrin veniddarin:
1.3: Haggoses, vehayyotze lehareg, lo niddar velo neerach. rabbi chanina ben akavya omer, neerach, mippene sheddamav ketzuvin, aval eno niddar, mippene sheen damav ketzuvin. rabbi yose omer, noder umaarich umakdish. veim hizzik, chayyav battashlumin:
1.4: Haishsha shehi yotza lehareg, en mamtinin lah ad shetteled. yashva al hammashber, mamtinin lah ad shetteled. haishsha shenneherga, nehenin bisarah. behema shenneherga, asura vahanaya:

2.1: En baarachin pachut missela, velo yater al chamishshim sala. ketzad, natan sela veheeshir, eno noten kelum. pachot missela veheeshir, noten chamishshim sala. haya veyadav chamesh selaim, rabbi meir omer, eno noten ella echat. vachachamim omrim, noten et kullam. en baarachin pachut missela, velo yater al chamishshim sela. en petach battoa pachut mishshiva, velo yater al shiva asar. en bannegaim pachut mishshavua echad, velo yater al shelosha shavuot:
2.2: En pochatin mearbaa chadashim hameubbarim beshana, velo nire yater al shemona. shete hallechem neechalot en pachut mishshenayim velo yater al shelosha. lechem happanim neechol en pachut mittisha velo yater al achad asar. katan nimmol en pachut mishshemona velo yater al shenem asar:
2.3: En pochatin meesrim veachat tekiot bammikdash velo mosifin al arbaim ushemone. en pochatin mishshene nevalin velo mosifin al shishsha. en pochatin mishshene chalilin velo mosifin al shenem asar. uvishnem asar yom bashshana hechalil makke lifne hammizbeach. bishchitat pesach rishon, uvishchitat pesach sheni, uveyom tov rishon shel pesach, uveyom tov shel atzeret, uvishmonat yeme hechag, velo haya makke beabbuv shel nechoshet ella beabbuv shel kane, mippene shekkolo arev. velo haya machalik ella veabbuv yechidi, mippene shehu machalik yafe:
2.4: Veavde hakkohanim hayu, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, mishpechot bet happegarim uvet tzefarya umeemmaom hayu massiin lakkehunna. rabbi chananya ben antignos omer, leviyyim hayu:
2.5: En pochatin mishshishsha telaim hamevukkarin belishkat hattelaim, keday lashshabbat velishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana, umosifin ad leolam. en pochatin mishshete chatzotzrot, umosifin ad leolam. en pochatin mittisha chinnorot, umosifin ad leolam. vehatztziltzal levad:
2.6: En pochatin mishshenem asar leviyyim omdim al hadduchan, umosifin ad leolam. en katan nichnas laazara laavoda ella veshaa shehaleviyyim omdim bashshir. velo hayu omrim benevel vechinnor ella vappe, kede litten teval banneima. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, en olin lamminyan, veen omdim al hadduchan, ella vaaretz hayu omdin, verashehen mibben ragle haleviyyim, vetzoare haleviyyim hayu nikrain:

3.1: Yesh baarachin lehakel ulehachamir, bisde achuzza lehakel ulehachamir, beshor hammuad shehemit et haeved lehakel ulehachamir, baones uvammefatte uvammotzi shem ra lehakel ulehachamir. yesh baarachin lehakel ulehachamir. ketzad. echad sheheerich et hannae shebbeyisrael veet hakkaur shebbeyisrael, noten chamishshim sala. veim amar hare damav alay, noten et shavyo:
3.2: Bisde achuzza lehakel ulehachamir. ketzad. echad hammakdish becholat hammachoz veechad hammakdish befardesot sebasti, noten bezera chomer seorim chamishshim shekel kesef. uvisde mikna, noten et shavyo. rabbi eliezer omer, echad sede achuzza veechad sede mikna. ma ben sede achuzza lisde mikna. ella shebbisde achuzza noten chomesh, uvisde mikna eno noten chomesh:
3.3: Beshor hammuad shehemit et haeved lehakel ulehachamir. ketzad. echad shehemit et hannae shebbaavadim veet hakkaur shebbaavadim, noten sheloshim sela. hemit ben chorin, noten et shavyo. chaval baze uvaze, meshallem nezek shalem:
3.4: Baones uvamfatte lehakel ulehachamir. ketzad. echad sheanas ufitta et haggedola shebbakkehunna veet hakketanna shebbeyisrael, noten chamishshim sela. vehabboshet vehappegam, hakkol lefi hamevayyesh vehammitbayyesh:
3.5: Bammotzi shem ra lehakel ulehachamir. ketzad. echad shehotzi shem ra al haggedola shebbakkehunna veal hakketanna shebbeyisrael, noten mea sela. nimtza haomer befiv yater min haose maase. shekken matzinu, shello nechtam gezar din al avotenu vammidbar ella al lashon hara, shenneemar (Bamidbar 14), vaynassu oti ze eser peamim velo shamu bekoli:

4.1: Hesseg yad, bannoder. vehashshanim, banniddar. vehaarachim, banneerach, vehaerech, bizman haerech. hesseg yad bannoder, ketzad. ani sheheerich et heashir, noten erech ani. veashir sheheerich et heani, noten erech ashir:
4.2: Aval bakkarbanot eno chen. hare sheamar, karbano shel metzora ze alay. im haya metzora ani, mevi karban ani. ashir, mevi karban ashir. rabbi omer, omer ani af baarachin ken. vechi mippene ma ani sheheerich et heashir noten erech ani, sheen heashir chayyav kelum. aval heashir sheamar erki alay, veshama heani veamar, ma sheamar ze alay, noten erech ashir. haya ani veheeshir o ashir veheeni, noten erech ashir. rabbi yehuda omer, afillu ani veheeshir vechazar veheeni, noten erech ashir:
4.3: Aval bakkarbanot eno chen, afillu aviv met vehinniach lo ribbo, sefinato vayyam uvau veribboot, en lahekdesh bahen kelum:
4.4: Shanim banniddar ketzad, yeled sheheerich et hazzaken, noten erech zaken. vezaken sheheerich et hayyeled, noten erech yeled. vaarachim banneerach ketzad, ish sheheerich et haishsha, noten erech ishsha. veishsha sheheericha et haish, notenet erech ish. vehaerech bizman haerech ketzad, heericho pachut mibben chamesh venaasa yoter al ben chamesh, pachut mibben esrim venaasa yoter al ben esrim, noten kizman haerech. yom sheloshim, kilmatta mimmennu. shenat chamesh ushenat esrim, kilmatta mimmennu, shenneemar (Vayikra 27), veim mibben shishshim shana vamala im zachar, hare anu lemedim bechullam mishshenat shishshim. ma shenat shishshim kilmatta mimmenna, af shenat chamesh ushenat esrim kilmatta mimmenna. hen. im asa shenat shishshim kilmatta mimmenna lehachamir, naase shenat chamesh ushenat esrim kilmatta mimmenna lehakel. talmud lomar, shana shana, ligzera shava. ma shana haamura vishnat shishshim, kilmatta mimmenna, af shana haamura vishnat chamesh ushenat esrim, kilmatta mimmenna, ben lehakel ben lehachamir. rabbi elazar omer, ad sheyyihyu yeterot al hashshanim chodesh veyom echad:

5.1: Haomer, mishkali alay, noten mishkalo. im kesef, kesef. im zahav, zahav. maase beimmah shel yirmatya sheamra, mishkal bitti alay, vealta lirushalayim, ushekaluha venatna mishkalah zahav. mishkal yadi alay, rabbi yehuda omer, memalle chavit mayim umachnisah ad marpeko, veshokel besar chamor vegidin vaatzamot venoten letochah ad shettitmalle. amar rabbi yose, vechi heach efshar lechavven basar keneged basar vaatzamot keneged atzamot. ella shamin et hayyad kamma hi reuya lishkol:
5.2: Deme yadi alay, shamin oto, kamma hu shave beyad, vechamma hu shave belo yad. ze chomer bannedarim mibbaarachin. vechomer baarachin mibbannedarim, ketzad. haomer, erki alay, vamet, yittenu hayyorshin. damay alay, vamet, lo yittenu hayyorshim, sheen damim lammetim. erech yadi veerech ragli alay, lo amar kelum. erech roshi veerech kevedi alay, noten erech kullo. ze hakkelal, davar shehanneshama teluya vo, noten erech kullo:
5.3: Chatzi erki alay, noten chatzi erko. erech chetzyi alay, noten erech kullo. chatzi damay alay, noten chatzi damav. deme chetzyi alay, noten deme chullo. ze hakkelal, davar shehanneshama teluya vo, noten erech kullo:
5.4: Haomer, erko shel peloni alay, met hannoder vehanniddar, yittenu hayyorshin. damav shel peloni alay, met hannoder, yittenu hayyorshin. met hanniddar, lo yittenu hayyorshin, sheen damim lammetim:
5.5: Shor ze ola, bayit ze karban, met hashshor venafal habbayit, eno chayyav leshallem. deme shor ze alay ola, o deme vayit ze alay karban, met hashshor venafal habbayit, chayyav leshallem:
5.6: Chayyave arachim, memashkenin otan. chayyave chattaot vaashamot, en memashkenin otan. chayyave olot ushelamim, memashkenin otan af al pi sheen mitkapper lo ad sheyyitratztze, shenneemar (Vayikra 1), lirtzono, kofin oto ad sheyyomar, rotze ani. vechen atta omer begitte nashim, kofin oto ad sheyyomar, rotze ani:

6.1: Shum hayetomim, sheloshim yom, veshum hahekdesh, shishshim yom, umachrizin babboker uvaarev. hammakdish nechasav vehayta alav ketubbat ishsha, rabbi eliezer omer, kesheyyegarshenna, yaddir hanaa. rabbi yehoshua omer, eno tzarich. kayotze vo amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, af hearev laishsha vichtubbata vehaya valah megarshah, yaddir hanaa, shemma yaase kenuneya al nechasav shel ze veyachazir et ishto:
6.2: Hammakdish nechasav vehayta alav ketubbat ishsha uvaal chov, en haishsha yechola ligbot ketubbatah min hahekdesh, velo vaal chov et chovo, ella happode fode al menat litten laishsha ketubbatah ulevaal chov et chovo. hikdish tishim mane vehaya chovo mea mane, mosif od dinar ufode vo et hannechasim hallalu, al menat litten laishsha ketubbatah ulevaal chov et chovo:
6.3: Af al pi sheamru, chayyave arachin memashkenin otan, notnin lo mezon sheloshim yom uchesut shenem asar chodesh umitta mutztzaat vesandalin utefillin. lo, aval lo leishto velo levanav. im haya umman, notnin lo shene chele ummanut mikkol min vamin. charash, notnin lo shene maatzadin ushete megerot. rabbi eliezer omer, im haya ikkar, notnin lo et tzimdo. chammar, notnin lo et chamoro:
6.4: Haya min echad merubbe umin echad muat, en omrim lo limkor min hamerubbe velikkach lo min hammuat, ella notnin lo shene minin min hamerubbe vechol sheyyesh lo min hammuat. hammakdish et nechasav, maalin lo et tefillav:
6.5: Echad hammakdish et nechasav, veechad hammaarich et atzmo, en lo, lo vichsut ishto, velo vichsut banav, velo vatztzeva shetztzevaan lishman, velo vesandalim chadashim shellekachan lishman. af al pi sheamru, avadim nimkarim bichsutan leshevach, sheim tillakach lo chesut bishloshim dinar, mashbiach hu mane, vechen para, im mamtinim otah laitlis, mashbachat hi, vechen margalit, im maalin otah lakkerach, mashbachat hi, en lahekdesh ella mekomo veshato:

7.1: En makdishin lifne hayyovel pachot mishshete shanim. velo goalin leachar hayyovel pachot mishshana. en mechashshevin chodashim lahekdesh. aval hahekdesh mechashshev chodashim. hammakdish et sadehu vishat hayyovel, noten bezera chomer seorim chamishshim shekel kasef. hayu sham nekaim amukkim asara tefachim o selaim gevohim asara tefachim, en nimdadim immah. pachot mikkan, nimdadim immah. hikdishah shetayim o shalosh shanim lifne hayyovel, noten sela ufundeyon leshana. im amar hareni noten devar shana veshana, en shomin lo, ella noten et kullo keechad:
7.2: Echad habbealim, veechad kol haadam. ma ben habbealim leven kol haadam, ella shehabbealim notnim chomesh, vechol adam eno noten chomesh:
7.3: Hikdishah ugealah, enah yotza miyyado bayyovel. gealah beno, yotza leaviv bayyovel. gealah acher o echad min hakkerovim ugealah miyyado, enah yotza miyyado bayyovel. gealah echad min hakkohanim vahare hi tachat yado, lo yomar hoil vehi yotza lakkohanim bayyovel vahare hi tachat yadi, hare hi shelli, ella yotza lechol echav hakkohanim:
7.4: Higgia hayyovel velo nigala, hakkohanim nichnasim letochah venotnim et dameha, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer, nichnasin, aval lo notnin. rabbi eliezer omer, lo nichnasin velo notnin, ella nikret sede retushim, ad hayyovel hashsheni. higgia hayyovel hashsheni velo nigala, nikret retushe retushin ad hayyovel hashshelishi. leolam en hakkohanim nichnasin letochah, ad sheyyigalenna acher:
7.5: Hallokeach sade meaviv, met aviv veachar kach hikdishah, hare hi kisde achuzza. hikdishah veachar kach met aviv, hare hi kisde mikna, divre rabbi meir. verabbi yehuda verabbi shimon omrim, kisde achuzza, shenneemar (Vayikra 27), veim et sede miknato asher lo missede achuzzato, sade sheenah reuya lihyot sede achuzza, yotzet zo, shehi reuya lihyot sede achuzza. sede mikna enah yotza lakkohanim bayyovel, sheen adam makdish davar sheeno shello. kohanim uleviyyim makdishim leolam, vegoalin leolam, ben lifne hayyovel, ben leachar hayyovel:

8.1: Hammakdish et sadehu beshaa sheenah yovel, omrim lo petach atta rishon, shehabbealim notnim chomesh, vechol adam eno noten chomesh. maase veechad shehikdish et sadehu mippene raatah, amru lo, petach atta rishon. amar, hare hi shelli veissar. amar rabbi yose, lo amar ze ella bechabbetza, shehahekdesh nifde vechesef uveshave chasef. amar lo, higgiatcha, nimtza mafsid issar, vesadehu lefanav:
8.2: Amar echad, hare hi shelli veeser selaim, veechad omer beesrim, veechad omer bishloshim, veechad omer bearbaim, veechad omer bachamishshim. chazar bo shel chamishshim, memashkenin minnechasav ad aser. chazar bo shel arbaim, memashkenin minnechasav ad aser. chazar bo shel sheloshim, memashkenin minnechasav ad aser. chazar bo shel esrim, memashkenim minnechasav ad aser. chazar bo shel eser, mochrim otah beshavyah venifraim mishshel eser et hammotar. habbealim omrim beesrim, vechol adam omrim beesrim, habbealim kodmim, mippene shehen mosifin chomesh:
8.3: Amar echad, hare hi shelli veesrim veachat, habbealim notnim esrim veshesh. beesrim ushetayim, habbealim notnim esrim vesheva. beesrim veshalosh, habbealim notnim esrim ushemone. beesrim vearba, habbealim notnim tisha veesrim. bachamishsha veesrim, habbealim notnim sheloshim, sheen mosifin chomesh al illuyo shel ze. amar echad, hare hi shelli beesrim vashesh, im ratzu habbealim litten sheloshim veechad vedinar, habbealim kodmim. veim lav, omrim, higgiatcha:
8.4: Macharim adam mitztzono umibbekaro, meavadav umishshifchotav hakkenaanim, umissede achuzzato. veim hecherim et kullan, enan muchramin, divre rabbi elazar. amar rabbi elazar ben azarya, ma im laggavoah, en adam rashshay lehacharim et kol nechasav, al achat kamma vechamma sheyyehe adam chayyav lihyot chas al nechasav:
8.5: Hammacharim beno uvitto, avdo veshifchato haivrim, usede miknato, enan muchramim, sheen adam macharim davar sheeno shello. kohanim uleviyyim enan macharimin, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer, hakkohanim enan macharimin, shehacharamim shellahem. haleviyyim macharimim, sheen hacharamim shellahen. rabbi omer, nirim divre rabbi yehuda bakkarkaot, shenneemar (Vayikra 25), ki achuzzat olam hu lahem, vedivre rabbi shimon bemittaltelim, sheen hacharamim shellahem:
8.6: Cherme chohanim en lahem pidyon, ella nittanim lakkohanim. rabbi yehuda ven betera omer, setam charamim levedek habbayit, shenneemar (sham 27), kol cherem kodesh kadashim hu laAdonai. vachachamim omrim, setam charamim lakkohanim, shenneemar (sham), kisde hacherem lakkohen tihye achuzzato. im ken, lamma neemar kol cherem kodesh kadashim hu laAdonai. shehu chal al kadshe kadashim veal kadashim kallim:
8.7: Macharim adam et kadashav, ben kadshe kadashim uven kadashim kallim. im neder, noten et haddamim. im nedava, noten et tovato. shor ze ola, omdim kamma adam rotze litten beshor ze lehaaloto ola, sheeno rashshay. habbechor, ben tamim ben baal mum, macharimin oto. ketzad podin oto. happodin omdim kamma adam rotze litten bivchor ze, litteno leven bitto o leven achoto. rabbi yishmael omer, katuv echad omer takdish, vechatuv echad omer al takdish. i efshar lomar takdish, shekkevar neemar al takdish, vei efshar lomar al takdish, shekkevar neemar takdish. emor meatta, makdisho atta hekdesh illuy, veen atta makdisho hekdesh mizbeach:

9.1: Hammocher et sadehu bishat hayyovel, eno muttar ligol pachut mishshete shanim, shenneemar (Vayikra 25), bemispar shene tevuot yimkar lach. hayta shenat shiddafon veyerakon o sheviit, enah ola min hamminyan. narah o hovirah, ola lo min hamminyan. rabbi elazar omer, mecharah lo lifne rosh hashshana vehi melea ferot, hare ze ochel mimmenna shalosh tevuot lishte shanim:
9.2: Mecharah larishon bemane, umachar harishon lashsheni bematayim, eno mechashshev ella im harishon, shenneemar, laish asher machar lo. mecharah larishon bematayim, umachar harishon lashsheni bemane, eno mechashshev ella im haacharon, shenneemar (sham), laish, laish asher betochah. lo yimkor berachok veyigol bekarov, bera veyigol beyafe. lo yilve veyigal, velo yigal lachatzaim. uvahekdesh muttar bechullan. ze chomer bahedyot mibbahekdesh:
9.3: Hammocher bayit bevatte are choma, hare ze goel miyyad, vegoel kol shenem asar chodesh, hare ze kemin ribbit veenah ribbit. met hammocher, yigal beno. met hallokeach, yigal miyyad beno. eno mone lo shana ella mishshaa shemmachar lo, shenneemar (sham), ad melot lo shana temima. ucheshehu omer temima, lehavi chodesh haibbur. rabbi omer, yitten lo shana veibburah:
9.4: Higgia yom shenem asar chodesh velo nigal, haya chalut lo, echad hallokeach veechad shennittan lo mattana, shenneemar latztzemitut. barishona haya nitman yom shenem asar chodesh, sheyyehe chalut lo. hitkin hillel hazzaken, sheyyehe cholesh et meotav ballishka, vihe shover et haddelet venichnas. ematay sheyyirtze halla, yavo veyittol et meotav:
9.5: Kol shehu lifnim min hachoma, hare hu chevatte are choma, chutz min hassadot. rabbi meir omer, af hassadot. bayit habbanuy bachoma, rabbi yehuda omer, eno chevatte are choma. rabbi shimon omer, kotel hachitzon hi chomato:
9.6: Ir sheggaggoteha chomatah, vesheenah mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun, enah kevatte are choma. veellu hen batte are choma, shalosh chatzerot shel shene shene vattim, mukkafot choma mimot yehoshua bin nun, kegon katztzera hayeshana shel tzipporim, vechakra shel gush chalav, veyodfat hayeshana, vegamla, ugedod, vechadid, veono, virushalayim, vechen kayyotze vahen:
9.7: Batte hachatzerim, notnim lahem koach hayyafe shebbevatte are choma vechoach hayyafe shebbassadot. nigalin miyyad, venigalin kol shenem asar chodesh kabbattim, veyotzim bayyovel uvegiron kesef kassadot. veellu hen batte chatzerim, shete chatzerot shel shene shene vattim, af al pi shemmukkafin choma mimot yehoshua bin nun, hare ellu chevatte chatzerim:
9.8: Yisrael sheyyarash avi immo levi, eno goel kasseder hazze. vechen levi sheyyarash et avi immo yisrael, eno goel kasseder hazze, shenneemar (Vayikra 25), ki vatte are haleviyyim, ad sheyhe levi uveare haleviyyim, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim, en haddevarim amurim ella veare haleviyyim. en osim sade migrash velo migrash sade, velo migrash ir velo ir migrash. amar rabbi eliezer, bamme devarim amurim. beare haleviyyim. aval beare yisrael, osin sade migrash velo migrash sade, migrash ir velo ir migrash, kede shello yacharivu et are yisrael. hakkohanim vehaleviyyim mochrim leolam vegoalim leolam, shenneemar (sham), geullat olam tihye lalviyyim:
